column12: Harness change

column3: Update prompt reference from CLAUDE.md to AGENTS.md
column11: Anthropic system prompt tells the agent to save lint/typecheck commands to AGENTS.md instead of CLAUDE.md.
column12: Edits the Claude-routed system prompt (anthropic.txt). The 'VERY IMPORTANT: run lint/typecheck when done' instruction now points to AGENTS.md instead of CLAUDE.md as the place to record those commands. No code change.
column13: A deliberate rename of the memory-file convention in the prompt; no defect is being fixed. Not reverted; no follow-up fix found.

column3: feat: add more ignore patterns to the ls tool
column11: list/ls tool skips more noise directories (coverage, vendor, tmp, cache, logs, venv/env).
column12: Extends IGNORE_PATTERNS in the ls (list) tool with .coverage, coverage/, vendor/, tmp/, temp/, .cache/, cache/, logs/, .venv/, venv/ and env/. Directory listings returned to the model now omit those trees, which shrinks output and changes what the agent sees.
column13: Feature extension of the default ignore list; nothing was broken. Not reverted; no follow-up fix found.

column3: Standardize parameter description references in Edit and MultiEdit tools
column11: Edit and multiedit tool descriptions now use camelCase parameter names (oldString/newString/replaceAll) everywhere.
column12: The edit, multiedit and edit.txt descriptions referred to old_string/new_string/replace_all while the zod schema used camelCase. This PR rewrites every reference in the tool descriptions to oldString/newString/replaceAll, so the model-facing tool definition matches the schema (PR targets GPT-4.1 parameter confusion).
column13: Tool-description wording change meant to shape model behavior (issue #985 is about model confusion, not a code defect). Not reverted; the next edit.ts change (#1287) is an unrelated new matcher.

column3: feat: pass mode into task tool
column11: Task subagents inherit the parent session's mode/agent instead of always running in 'build'.
column12: The task tool used to spawn every subagent session in 'build' mode. It now passes the parent message's mode, and assistant messages record their mode (with a storage migration that backfills 'build'). Subagents therefore get the same tool and permission set as the calling mode.
column13: A design change to subagent delegation semantics (described as a feature). Not reverted; #1642 (13 days later) only adds an 'unknown agent type' error and does not undo it.

column3: add support for lsp workspace/didChangeConfiguration
column11: LSP client sends workspace/didChangeConfiguration with the server's initialization settings (e.g. the TypeScript server).
column12: When a language server has initialization options, which the built-in TypeScript server does, the client now answers workspace/configuration with them and sends workspace/didChangeConfiguration after init. This can change the diagnostics servers report back into edit/write tool results.
column13: Adds a new LSP protocol capability (issue #2180 is a feature request). Not reverted; no follow-up fix found.

column3: tweak: update ls tool to use rg
column11: list tool enumerates files via ripgrep (gitignore-aware) instead of Bun.Glob.
column12: The ls tool's file enumeration moved from a Bun.Glob('**/*') scan with substring ignores to Ripgrep.files with negated globs and the same LIMIT. Ripgrep honors .gitignore and hidden-file rules, so listings shown to the model differ in content and ordering.
column13: Implementation change chosen by maintainers ('this should be done'); not addressing a defect. Not reverted; no follow-up fix found.

column3: feat: allow read tool to handle images
column11: read tool returns images as attachments for image-capable models instead of erroring.
column12: Adds model modalities to provider metadata. When the active model supports image input, read on an image file now returns the image as a file attachment; before, it threw 'Use a different tool to process images'. Non-image models still get an error.
column13: New capability (issue #2657 is a feature request). Not reverted. The model-info plumbing was hardened later in #4473 (Nov 2025), outside the 2-week window.

column3: fix: adjust list tool prompt to handle cwd better
column11: list tool description: path may be omitted to default to the workspace directory.
column12: Rewrites the ls tool description from 'path must be an absolute path, not a relative path' to 'path must be absolute; omit it to use the current workspace directory'. Only the prompt text changes.
column13: A prompt-guidance tweak despite the 'fix:' title; no code path changes. Not reverted; no follow-up fix found.

column3: feat: retry parts
column11: Model-call retries handled by opencode's own loop (up to 10, with backoff and retry parts) instead of the AI SDK's maxRetries.
column12: Sets the AI SDK maxRetries to 0 for the main loop and compaction and adds a harness-level retry loop. Retryable API errors are recorded as 'retry' message parts and retried up to 10 times with SessionRetry backoff delays. This changes when and how failed model calls are retried mid-turn.
column13: New retry architecture (a feature PR). Not reverted; no follow-up fix to this logic within 2 weeks.

column3: adjust edit tool multiple matches error wording
column11: Edit tool's multiple-matches error tells the model to include more surrounding lines in oldString.
column12: Rewords the error returned to the model when oldString matches several times, to 'Found multiple matches for oldString. Include more surrounding code lines in oldString to uniquely identify which occurrence to replace.' The matching logic is unchanged; only the recovery guidance differs.
column13: Feedback-text change to steer model recovery (issue #3030, 'Model is confused by tool errors'); not a code defect. Not reverted; no follow-up fix found.

column3: allow task tool to have resume capabilities
column11: task tool can resume an existing subagent session via session_id and returns that id in its output.
column12: Adds an optional session_id parameter to the task tool. If it is given, the subagent continues that session instead of starting a new one. Task output now ends with <task_metadata>session_id: ...</task_metadata>, and task.txt says invocations are stateless unless a session_id is supplied.
column13: New feature (resumable subagents). Not reverted; no follow-up fix found within 2 weeks.

column3: tweak: compaction prompt
column11: Compaction prompt rewritten so the summary is a self-contained continuation prompt.
column12: Replaces the summarization instruction ('detailed but concise summary...') with one that says the summary will be the only context available afterwards, so it must preserve critical information. compaction.txt adds sections for persistent user constraints and key technical decisions. This changes what survives auto-compaction.
column13: Deliberate prompt redesign; the body says post-compaction context was too thin. Not reverted. The follow-up 'fix: compaction type issue' is type-only.

column3: tweak: bash tool messages regarding timeouts and truncation more clear for agent
column11: Bash tool reports truncation, timeout and abort in a <bash_metadata> block instead of inline parentheticals.
column12: The bash tool used to append '(Output was truncated...)', '(Command timed out...)' or '(Command was aborted)' directly to stdout. It now appends a <bash_metadata> block whose messages state the output limit or timeout value, so the model can tell tool-level events apart from command output.
column13: Deliberate change to the model-facing output format (the body says models were confused). Not reverted; later bash.ts changes (#5131, #5140) build on it.

column3: tweak: bash tool improve output metadata for agent consumption, fix small timeout issue
column11: Bash metadata messages attribute truncation/timeout to the bash tool; streaming output is capped at the max length.
column12: Rewords the <bash_metadata> lines to 'bash tool truncated output as it exceeded N char limit' and 'bash tool terminated command after exceeding timeout'. It stops accumulating streamed output past MAX_OUTPUT_LENGTH and adds 100 ms of slack to the timeout timer.
column13: Mostly an output-wording design tweak; the title also mentions a 'small timeout issue' (+100 ms), so this is partly a fix. Not reverted; no follow-up fix found.

column3: tweak: make bash give agent more awareness of cwd, bump default timeout, drop max timeout
column11: Bash tool gains a workdir parameter, default timeout goes from 1 to 2 min, and the 10-min max cap is dropped.
column12: Adds a 'workdir' parameter (description: 'Use this instead of cd'), checked against external-directory permission. DEFAULT_TIMEOUT changes from 60s to 120s and MAX_TIMEOUT (10 min) is removed, so model-requested timeouts are unbounded. bash.txt is updated to match.
column13: Deliberate defaults and feature change. Not reverted; #5676 (11 days later) removes a run_in_background mention that this PR did not add.

column3: feat: add server_error, rate_limit, and no_kv_space retry logic to accommodate Foundry API issues
column11: Retry logic classifies rate_limit, server_error and no_kv_space stream errors as retryable.
column12: Extends the session retry classifier. JSON error payloads with rate_limit codes, type server_error, or a no_kv_space message now map to retryable states ('Rate Limited' / 'Provider Server Error') instead of terminating the turn. This affects generic providers that emit those codes (motivated by Azure Foundry).
column13: Adds new retry coverage (a feature PR; it notes possible side effects for other providers). Not reverted; a later 'tweak: more retry cases' extends it further.

column3: Add support for LSP workspace/didChangeWatchedFiles
column11: LSP client sends workspace/didChangeWatchedFiles on file create/change so servers like pyright re-resolve imports.
column12: Declares the didChangeWatchedFiles capability and sends Created/Changed notifications when the agent writes or touches files. Servers that rely on file watching (e.g. pyright) stop reporting stale 'cannot resolve import' diagnostics back to the model after it creates new modules.
column13: Implements an unsupported LSP capability (a feature PR), although it is motivated by noisy diagnostics. Not reverted; no follow-up fix found.

column3: Simplify directory tree output for prompts
column11: System-prompt project tree is a flat breadth-first list of directories, capped at 50 (was a 200-entry <files> tree).
column12: The environment section of the system prompt used to include a <files> tree of up to 200 entries. It now includes a <directories> block with a flat breadth-first list of directory paths only, limited to 50. This shrinks and restructures the initial repository context the model gets.
column13: Deliberate context-policy redesign ('simplify'); nothing was broken. Not reverted; no follow-up fix found.

column3: tweak: adjust task tool description/input to alleviate tool call failures that sometimes occured w/ gpt models
column11: task tool's resume parameter renamed to task_id; output wrapped in <task_result> with a task_id header.
column12: Renames session_id to task_id with a longer description saying to set it only when resuming. The task tool's output format changes to 'task_id: ... (for resuming...)' followed by <task_result>...</task_result>, and the task.txt wording on fresh context vs. resume is updated.
column13: Interface and description redesign to reduce tool-call failures (a 'tweak'). Not reverted; the only later change, #12497, is a UI render fix.

column3: feat: adjust read tool so that it can handle dirs too
column11: read tool lists directory contents and uses XML-style <path>/<type>/<content> output blocks.
column12: read now stats the path. For a directory it returns a sorted entry listing with offset/limit paging; files are wrapped in <path>, <type> and <content> tags. edit.txt is updated to match the new read output and error wording.
column13: New capability plus an output-format redesign. Not reverted; later read.ts changes (#13198, #14009) are separate design and performance work.

column3: tweak: make read tool offset 1 indexed instead of 0 to avoid confusion that could be caused by line #s being 1 based
column11: read tool offset is now 1-indexed to match the displayed line numbers.
column12: Changes read's offset from 0-based to 1-based: the default is 1, offset < 1 raises an error, and out-of-range offsets error. @file line ranges in prompts are mapped the same way, and read.txt documents the 1-indexed offset.
column13: Deliberate API-semantics change to avoid off-by-one confusion. Not reverted within 2 weeks; #25431 (~3 months later) relaxes the offset=0 error.

column3: tweak: tool outputs to be more llm friendly
column11: Edit, glob and grep error and truncation messages are more explicit for the model.
column12: Rewords edit errors ('Could not find oldString in the file. It must match exactly, including whitespace...', 'No changes to apply...'). Glob and grep truncation notices now state how many results are shown and hidden. grep's header reports the total match count rather than the truncated count.
column13: Feedback-text redesign ('more LLM friendly'). Not reverted; no follow-up fix found.

column3: feat(tool): return image attachments from webfetch
column11: webfetch returns fetched images as image attachments instead of decoding them as text.
column12: When the HTTP response content-type is an image (excluding SVG), webfetch returns 'Image fetched successfully' plus a base64 data-URL file attachment that the model can view. Before, all bodies were decoded as text.
column13: New capability (a feature PR). Not reverted; #13890 later only moves attachment-id assignment.

column3: tweak: adjust way skills are presented to agent to increase likelyhood of skill invocations.
column11: System prompt gains a skills section (or 'No skills are currently available.') and a 'Workspace root folder' environment line.
column12: Adds SystemPrompt.skills(), injected between the environment and instruction blocks. It explains skills, tells the model to use the skill tool, and lists available skills (or says none are available). The environment block also adds the worktree root path. The system prompt changes even when no skills exist.
column13: Deliberate presentation change to raise skill usage. Not reverted. #18261 (8 days later) adds deterministic ordering of agents and skills, which addresses pre-existing nondeterminism and does not undo this.

column3: tweak: adjust skill presentation to be a little less token heavy
column11: Skills are listed verbosely (XML) in the system prompt and tersely (markdown bullets) in the skill tool description.
column12: Skill.fmt gains a verbose option: the system prompt uses the XML <available_skills> form and the skill tool description uses a compact '## Available Skills' bullet list. This lowers tokens in the tool definition. With zero skills, both still say 'No skills are currently available.'
column13: Deliberate token and presentation trade-off. Not reverted; no follow-up fix found. Expected near-null effect when no skills are installed.

column3: tweak: remove unnecessary parts from the fallback system prompt
column11: Fallback system prompt (default.txt, formerly qwen.txt) drops the 'refuse malicious code' instructions.
column12: Renames qwen.txt to default.txt as the fallback prompt for models without a dedicated prompt. Removes the two 'IMPORTANT: Refuse to write code... that may be used maliciously' paragraphs and keeps a softer 'think about what the code is supposed to do'. Only models routed to the fallback prompt are affected.
column13: Prompt-policy change. The linked issue #17839 (bug-labeled) is about over-refusal, a model-behavior complaint, not a code defect. Not reverted; no follow-up fix found.

column3: tweak: only spawn lsp servers for files in current instance (or cwd if instance is global)
column11: LSP servers are spawned only for files inside the current instance directory.
column12: LSP.getClients now returns no clients for files outside the instance directory (or cwd for a global instance). Edits and reads of files outside the project no longer start language servers or produce diagnostics for the model.
column13: Deliberate scoping policy ('tweak'). Not reverted; no follow-up fix found.

column3: tweak: add newline between <content> and first line of read tool output to prevent confusion
column11: read output puts a newline after <content> so the first numbered line starts on its own line.
column12: Changes the read tool's output header from '<content>1: ...' to '<content>' followed by a newline and then '1: ...'. This is a formatting change to every file read the model sees, meant to stop the tag from being confused with line 1.
column13: Output-format tweak to reduce model confusion; no code defect. Not reverted; no follow-up fix found.

column3: improve bash timeout retry hint
column11: Bash timeout message tells the model it may retry with a larger timeout if the command is long-running and not interactive.
column12: Extends the <bash_metadata> timeout line to say that if the command is expected to take longer and is not waiting for interactive input, the model can retry with a larger timeout, and should avoid blind retries otherwise. This changes the agent's recovery guidance after timeouts.
column13: Guidance-text improvement (closes feature request #4197, 'Set timeout for long running commands'). Not reverted; #22660 (bash memory) is unrelated.

column3: feat: support pull diagnostics in the LSP client (C#, Kotlin, etc)
column11: LSP client supports pull diagnostics; edit/write wait for document diagnostics with bounded timeouts.
column12: Adds textDocument/diagnostic and workspace/diagnostic pull support, capability registration and wait timeouts (5s document, 10s full, 3s per request). edit, write and apply_patch now call touchFile(file, 'document'). Diagnostics for pull-only servers (Roslyn/C#, Kotlin) now reach the model, and wait timing changes for others.
column13: New protocol capability (a feature PR); C# diagnostics were never supported before. Not reverted; no follow-up fix found. NOTE: the GitHub mergeCommit (8cade05bc6) is not on dev; use the dev commit listed here.

column3: tweak: adjust order of system prompt instructions: Global, Project, Skills
column11: System prompt order changed to environment, then global then project instructions, then skills (skills moved last; global before project).
column12: In the system prompt, the skills block moves from before the AGENTS.md/instruction files to after them. Global instruction files are now added before project ones. Content is unchanged; only ordering and precedence position change.
column13: Deliberate ordering policy (issue #22346 asks which should take precedence). Not reverted; no follow-up fix found.

column3: Preapprove agent tmp directory access
column11: Agent gets a pre-approved opencode tmp directory outside the workspace, advertised in the bash tool prompt.
column12: Creates <os tmpdir>/opencode, adds it to the external_directory whitelist for agents, and adds a line to bash.txt: 'Use ${tmp} for temporary work outside the workspace. This directory is pre-approved.' Headless runs can now use that tmp directory without permission prompts or rejections.
column13: New permission default plus a prompt addition (a feature). Not reverted; no follow-up fix found.

column3: tweak: allow read tool to accept offset of 0
column11: read tool treats offset 0 as offset 1 instead of erroring.
column12: Removes the 'offset must be greater than or equal to 1' failure. An offset of 0 (or other falsy values) now falls back to 1, so 0-based reads by the model succeed instead of costing a failed tool call.
column13: Deliberate input-tolerance tweak relaxing #13198's strictness (~3 months later, not a follow-up fix). Not reverted; a later byte-cap stream fix is unrelated.

column3: core: reduce prompts for shell, todowrite, and task tools
column11: Shell, todowrite and task tool descriptions and the fallback system prompt cut heavily (~280 lines removed).
column12: Removes the long git commit/PR protocol from shell.txt, shrinks todowrite.txt from about 211 lines to a short description, trims task.txt usage notes, and drops the terse-answer examples from default.txt. This greatly reduces tool-definition tokens; the body argues modern models don't need the detail.
column13: Deliberate prompt-reduction design change. Not reverted; #27872 changes the background-task text in task.txt (a separate flag-gated feature), not this reduction.
